jobs.title: Marketing Wealth Management Intern
jobs.description:
Do you consider yourself a creative person and looking to learn more about the world of marketing? Do you have an special interest for events organization? Do you want to learn more on how the planning, content, logistics and execution of marketing events and other activities across the continent can add value to our clients?

We’re looking for a marketing intern to help us:

• support the plan, development and execution of marketing projects.
• support administrative tasks for execution of UBS events in Latin America.
• work collaboratively with internal partners across internal/corporate communications, brand, media, web platforms, external agency partners, and third-party event partners.
• produce client literature including factsheets, presentations, email invitations, event announcements, among others.
• make sure marketing materials comply with our brand guidelines, policies and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Java Developer
jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Java Developer in Morrisville, NC

Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Java Developer to:
• Design, code, conduct code reviews, and testing software as needed. Develop code, implement client, server and web-based applications, web services and unit testing. Lead participation in application architecture and design and other phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and implement a robust set of web services and APIs to power web applications.
• Development of various application components. Implemented all the front-end components using Spring MVC. Lead the technical design of application components in concert with CTO, DISO (Divisional Information Security Office) & team leads.
• Drive and ensure code quality, monitoring & Observability, UT and SIT testing guidelines and procedures are met. Lead the adoption of Innovative technologies (like Open AI) to boost developer and QA productivity. Triage with global development teams and business stakeholders to ensure project timelines are met.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001623. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary & Work Schedule: $145,000/year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in real estate asset management? Are you an expert in quality management and do you have strong analytical skills? Would you like to use your skill set and knowledge to support our local product teams in Switzerland, responsible for managing the real estate investment products in the DACH region?

We’re looking for a quality management specialist to support the real estate investment teams in their daily tasks such as:

• maintenance, modification, and quality assurance of master data, including ongoing validation of monthly data imports provided by external property management companies
• performance of data analyses and KPI monitoring to ensure data accuracy
• preparation, review, and coordination of regular and ad-hoc reports for real estate asset managers in Switzerland
• initiation, coordination and monitoring of operational processes for the Asset Management department
• administration and support of external marketing mandates
• further development and maintenance of the central, CRM-based tenant and concept database, including AI-supported data validation and automated quality checks
• coordination of tenant credit checks and operator risk monitoring, including preliminary analyses to identify patterns and potential early risk indicators
• execution and coordination of Know-Your-Clients (KYC) and third-party checks in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
• support of audit-relevant quality controls, ensuring compliance with documentation, retention, and archiving guidelines
• active participation in real estate asset management projects and collaboration with external partner

jobs.description:
Are you curious about how large global organizations manage technology risk at scale?
Do you enjoy analysing complex problems and turning data into actionable insight?
Are you eager to start your career in a team that safeguards the bank’s stability through modern risk management practices?
If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS!

As a part of your team, you will:

• Analyze technology risk data, reports and metrics to identify patterns, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk dashboards, reporting, and governance materials.
• Support automation, tooling enhancements, and AI adoption initiatives impacting technology risk.
• Work with stakeholders to incorporate risk and control requirements into application development backlogs.
• Assist in assessing control effectiveness and evaluating adherence to UBS policies and guidelines.

Tech Graduate Program
You will be participating in our immersive global graduate program. Not only will you connect with peers worldwide, it will offer you:
Hands-on Experience: Gain exposure to a variety of tech projects from day one.
Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay updated with the latest tech.
Professional Development: Enhance your technical skills through training and understand our business.
Guidance from experts: Receive insights, advice, and support from our experienced professionals.
Environment: Collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas across organization.
Career Advancement: 18 months comprehensive Tech Graduate Program kicks off in August 2026, ensuring your growth and success at UBS.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a structurer to play a role within our Fixed Income Structuring team, with a particular focus on rates and FX markets. The role combines product origination, client engagement, advanced structuring, and pricing.
Key responsibilities include:
• Structuring, pricing, execution, and documentation of complex fixed income transactions across OTC and structured note formats
• Originate trade ideas and client solutions, working closely with sales to engage directly with clients, understand their objectives, and deliver tailored outcomes
• Design, model, and price bespoke payoffs across FX and rates products, including scenario analysis, stress testing, and lifecycle risk management
• Provide expertise on documentation, including ISDA, credit annexes, and structured note documentation, coordinating with legal, operations, and risk to ensure robust execution

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role:
This role will continue to drive key responsibilities within the STAAT Analytics team. The candidate will lead the development of scalable, insight-driven dashboards and advanced analytical solutions that empower strategic decision-making for financial advisory and market leadership. The role requires a strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring stakeholders have the tools and intelligence needed to optimize performance and identify growth opportunities.

• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis and develop predictive models to drive key strategic initiatives.

• Automate data pipelines and reporting workflows using Python and Power BI, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytics deliverables are aligned with overarching business objectives.

jobs.description:
UBS Financial Services INC is seeking a Managing Director, UGM OTC Equity Solutions in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Do you know how to engage different kinds of people on a variety of topics?

We’re looking for a Managing Director, UGM OTC Equity Solutions to:
• Design new equity derivative financial products, using swaps, put options, call options, path-dependent Asian options, and exotics. Structure financial products with a sophisticated understanding of fundamental quantitative and mathematic analytical techniques, including calculus, to price and trade.
• Develop models using the analytical and mathematical tools gained through work in mathematics. Analyze single stock volatility surfaces, market volatility surfaces, interest rate environments globally, and foreign exchange rates globally.
• Predict changes in the strategy’s economics from the client’s perspective and the UBS’s perspective based on changes in stock volatility, interest rates, exchange rates, and the correlation of the three. Assist non-quantitative professionals to fully understand all the risks and potential outcomes of strategies based on changes and expectations in these markets.
• Interpret client goals into equity products, equity derivatives to produce desirable economic outcomes for the client and acceptable UBS risk parameters Design equity products by manipulating the data to produce various results. Interpret results and changes value drivers to produce desired results.
• Write user-friendly interfaces for the equity derivative pricing models built, which in turn are used by other team members for pricing and risk determination for use in presenting solutions to various parties internally for approval, and for client presentations. Adapt product features, models, and marketing materials for new changes in product design, and designs mathematical formulas on product and strategy implementation.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Software Engineer in Morrisville, NC
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Software Engineer to:
• Design, implement, and maintain a scalable CI/CD platform to automate code integration, testing, deployment, compliance verification and infrastructure provision for software development teams across all divisions. Embed security best practices into the software development lifecycle by automating vulnerability scans, compliance checks, and secure code deployment and meet UBS policies and standards.
• Liaise between platform engineering and application development teams, promoting best practices and reusable solutions. Design platform monitoring and logging solutions to track performance, detect anomalies, and ensure system stability. Integrate machine learning models and services into the developer platforms, enabling intelligent automation and enhanced developer productivity.
• Integrate observability tools to provide actionable insights and support proactive incident response. Provide documentation, training, and support to enable teams to effectively use developer platform tools and services. Develop and maintain operational infrastructure and tooling to support software artifact deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
• Reducing manual intervention and accelerating delivery cycles. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you excited to work with a global team with diverse backgrounds and talents? Can you apply your technical skills to help quantify business risks? Do you enjoy the challenge of driving business impact through analytics and are looking for an opportunity to lead innovation?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to:

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.
• work collaboratively with stakeholders to assist in risk assessments and highlight high-risk areas for deep dives.
• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into a true asset that drives innovation and growth? Do you have the expertise and vision to help shape the future of data management for a leading global asset manager? If so, we want you to join our Chief Data Office (CDO) team as a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst.

We at UBS Asset Management believe that data is not just information – it’s one of our most valuable assets. Our mission is to establish data as a value driver and enabler of strategic innovation across the firm. We are seeking a driven, forward-thinking individual who can help us build the next generation of data platforms and unlock the potential of AI and GenAI for the future.

Your role:
As a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building and managing the data foundation of UBS Asset Management, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing the Roadmap: Define and prioritize the product roadmap for all applications supporting our data foundation, ensuring alignment with the CDO’s strategic vision.
- Business Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders across UBS Asset Management to analyze business requirements, define use cases, and translate them into actionable projects.
- As-Is Process & Data Flow Analysis: Conduct comprehensive assessments of current data flows, processes, and systems to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency.
- Target Operating Model & Data Architecture Design: Work closely with data engineers and architects to design the target operating model and data architecture that will transform our data management landscape.
- Data Analytics & Insights: Leverage data analytics to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data, providing insights that drive business decisions and improve data quality.
- Documentation & User Support: Ensure all data systems and processes are well-documented, including process flows, data dictionaries, and user guides. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.
